_comment: Config/policy DATA for the feedback phase (survey URL, IDE detection, share-link payload rules, redaction). KNOWLEDGE per docs/unit-taxonomy-spec.md (URLs/thresholds/patterns evolve independently of the collect algorithm). Output SHAPES: schemas/feedback.schema.json + schemas/feedback-trace.schema.json.

survey._note: ide + plugin_version are hidden URL fields the user never sees; sanitize both to [a-zA-Z0-9._~-].

ide_detection._comment: Detect from environment if available (NOT deterministic across environments — read env, else fallback). First match wins.

plugin_version.source: search UPWARD from the skill root for the nearest plugin.json; if multiple variants exist at the same level, precedence .claude-plugin > .codex > .cursor; read its version

share_link._comment: OPTIONAL + NON-BLOCKING — failures NEVER halt the phase. Runs when an OBSERVABLE share signal is present: preferences.json + estimation-infra.json exist AND a share was requested (.phase-status.json.share_requested == true OR preferences.metadata.share_requested == true). If no such flag, default to NOT generating the link (skip). The trigger must be an observable artifact value — never invocation provenance.
share_link.enabled_when: preferences.json AND estimation-infra.json exist AND (.phase-status.json.share_requested == true OR preferences.metadata.share_requested == true); else skip

encode._comment: The encoding is real computation a cold LLM cannot do by hand — SHELL OUT. Minify JSON, then gzip, then Base64URL. Strip newlines AND padding (portable across GNU/BSD base64).
encode.steps: minify the payload JSON -> gzip -> base64url
encode.shell: printf '%s' "$MINIFIED_JSON" | gzip -c | base64 | tr -d '\n' | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '='
encode.on_failure: skip the share link (non-blocking); record share_link_presented=false

truncation_order: if still > cap, skip the share link entirely

redaction._comment: Scan clarify_answers (and anything echoed into the payload/trace) for secrets; replace with '[REDACTED]'. The trace NEVER includes resource names, file paths, account IDs, or secrets at all.

completion.done_message: Thank you for helping improve this tool. Migration planning is complete.
